statement: A change to an app document that defines a system role whose id another app's head already defines carries a warning (REFERENCES) naming the role and the other apps, never a refusal: a membership is role@space with no app in it, so a member whose roles are not issued per app holds the role in every app that defines its id. The check reads the app list and those apps' heads, never a tenant document.
guards: control:SharedRoleIdTest#an app that defines a system role another app defines is warned, naming the role and the app
control:SharedRoleIdTest#an app whose role ids no other app defines is not warned
control:SharedRoleIdTest#an app that defines a role another app defines still publishes, keeping the warning
